anomalies.observed: The VDD power pins of both MCUs are not connected to any supply net; they appear as unconnected nets in the netlist.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the 3.3 V rail powers the MCUs, so all VDD pins should be connected to the 3.3 V rail.

evidence.quote: 3.3 V rail: An LD39200PU33R LDO, fed from the 5 V rail, produces 3V3 for "MCUs and Sensors"

anomalies.impact: The MCUs receive no core power and cannot operate, making the board completely non-functional.

anomalies.observed: The FCC HSE crystal is connected to PE6 (pin 5) and PE7 (pin 37) instead of the HSE pins PH0/PH1. The NAVC HSE crystal is not connected to the MCU at all.
anomalies.expected: The HSE crystal should be connected to the dedicated HSE pins (PH0/PH1) of each MCU, as required by the STM32H753 and STM32F405 pinouts.
anomalies.impact: The MCUs cannot use the external crystal for their main clock, preventing reliable operation or booting.

anomalies.observed: The netlist contains no CH330 USB-UART bridge ICs, although the specification lists two CH330 devices.
anomalies.expected: Two CH330 USB-UART bridge ICs should be present to provide USB-to-UART programming/debug interfaces.

evidence.quote: No component with value or part name CH330 appears in the components list.

anomalies.impact: The USB programming/debug interfaces are non-functional, preventing firmware upload and serial communication over USB.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple severe anomalies: both MCUs lack VDD power connections, the HSE crystals are miswired or disconnected, and the specified CH330 USB-UART bridges are missing. These deviations would prevent the board from operating as intended.
